acceptedWorkstreams.title: Adapt the parent kit for primary and secondary school families
acceptedWorkstreams.description: The goal covers K-12, but a parent of a young child and a parent of a teenager may need different explanations and questions. Reuse one shared, source-checked fact sheet, then provide two short age-band versions of the letter and FAQ. Include a comparison table showing what changes and what must stay consistent, flag every age or data-handling claim for school/Zedu confirmation, and test the wording against fictional parent questions only. This adds age-appropriate communication without collecting real pupil or family information.
